response.sql: WITH rating_stats AS (SELECT f.rating, AVG(f.length) AS avg_length, AVG(f.rental_rate / f.rental_duration) AS per_day_rate FROM film f WHERE f.length IS NOT NULL GROUP BY f.rating), mean_per_day AS (SELECT AVG(per_day_rate) AS mean_rate FROM rating_stats), above_mean AS (SELECT rs.avg_length, rs.per_day_rate, m.mean_rate FROM rating_stats rs CROSS JOIN mean_per_day m WHERE rs.per_day_rate > m.mean_rate) SELECT AVG(avg_length) AS average_length, AVG(per_day_rate) AS average_per_day_rate, AVG(per_day_rate - mean_rate) AS average_excess FROM above_mean;

assumptions.assumption: The final output aggregates the filtered ratings as units (averaging their per-rating statistics), rather than pooling films across those ratings

alternatives.interpretation: Pool all films across the selected ratings and compute average length, average per-day rate, and average excess for the films themselves rather than for the ratings
alternatives.sql: WITH rating_stats AS (SELECT f.rating, AVG(f.length) AS avg_length, AVG(f.rental_rate / f.rental_duration) AS per_day_rate FROM film f WHERE f.length IS NOT NULL GROUP BY f.rating), mean_per_day AS (SELECT AVG(per_day_rate) AS mean_rate FROM rating_stats), selected_ratings AS (SELECT rs.rating FROM rating_stats rs CROSS JOIN mean_per_day m WHERE rs.per_day_rate > m.mean_rate) SELECT AVG(f.length) AS average_length, AVG(f.rental_rate / f.rental_duration) AS average_per_day_rate, AVG(f.rental_rate / f.rental_duration - m.mean_rate) AS average_excess FROM film f CROSS JOIN mean_per_day m WHERE f.length IS NOT NULL AND f.rating IN (SELECT rating FROM selected_ratings);
